<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state more carefully
seg = current_frame.segmentation
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

# Check player row for trail color
row20 = ascii_lines[20]
print(f"Row 20: {row20[10:50]}")

# Check what the trail segment is
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('g', 'N', 'w') and n['pixels'] <= 10:
        center_r = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        center_c = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        if 15 < center_c < 25 and 18 < center_r < 24:
            print(f"Small object: color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, center~({center_r:.0f},{center_c:.0f})")

# Extend trail to reach red block
# Red block at col 42, player trail starts at col 16
# Gap: ~26 cells, need about 4-5 RIGHT actions
result = action(['RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT'])
print(f"\nAfter 4 RIGHTs:")
row20 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[20]
print(f"Row 20: {row20[10:50]}")

# Check red block
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'R' and n['pixels'] == 16 and sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary']) < 50:
        print(f"Red block: boundary={n['boundary']}, children={n['children']}")

# Check score
print(f"Score check: step={current_frame.step}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
